agency_bureau: Office of the Chief Information Officer
problem_solved: Manual classification of incoming policy documents is slow and error-prone. This tool automatically categorizes documents into predefined topic areas to route them to the correct review teams.
benefits: Reduces average document triage time from 4 hours to under 10 minutes per document; improves routing accuracy; frees analyst capacity for higher-value review tasks.
system_outputs: A topic-area label and a confidence score are attached to each ingested document and surfaced in the internal document management portal.
data_description: Internal unclassified policy memos, procurement notices, and administrative correspondence ingested from the GSA enterprise content management system.
